paragraphs.source_en: “In war, nothing is more dangerous than carelessness. If someone knows where I sit to hear the flute, he might fire upon me with a matchlock by daylight, and I could lose my life. Only one night remains. You must all stay vigilant.”

paragraphs.source_en: The moon slipped behind the clouds. The fifty-two years of Shingen’s life passed vividly before his eyes. He had first gone to war at sixteen; before he knew it, thirty-six springs had passed, the years flowing by like a song.

units.source_en: The moon slipped behind the clouds.

units.source_zh: 五十二年的人生，信玄历历在目。

units.source_en: He had first gone to war at sixteen; before he knew it, thirty-six springs had passed, the years flowing by like a song.
units.source_zh: 十六岁那年初次出战，不觉间过去了三十六个春秋，岁月如歌。

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly several tremendous booms rang out, as though they would split the valley, the earth, and the river apart. Hearing the reports come from the place where the camp stool had stood moments before, Shingen sprang violently to his feet.

units.source_en: Suddenly several tremendous booms rang out, as though they would split the valley, the earth, and the river apart.
units.source_zh: 突然，“嗵嗵”几声巨响，仿佛要把山谷、大地、河流都要震裂了。

units.source_en: Hearing the reports come from the place where the camp stool had stood moments before, Shingen sprang violently to his feet.
units.source_zh: 信玄听到从刚才放床几的那个位置，传来了几声响，便猛地跳了起来。

paragraphs.source_en: In that instant, Shingen was overcome by bitter indignation. Though Mount Tai collapse before him, his face should not change; though the Yellow River burst its banks beside him, his spirit should not falter. Shingen had spared no effort to cultivate such composure, and believed he had truly attained it.

units.source_en: In that instant, Shingen was overcome by bitter indignation.
units.source_zh: 那一瞬间，信玄突然感到愤懑无比。

units.source_en: Though Mount Tai collapse before him, his face should not change; though the Yellow River burst its banks beside him, his spirit should not falter.
units.source_zh: 泰山崩于前而色不沮，黄河决于侧而神不惊。

units.source_en: Shingen had spared no effort to cultivate such composure, and believed he had truly attained it.
units.source_zh: 为了练就此种心态，信玄可谓费尽苦心，他认为自己确实达到了此等境界。

paragraphs.source_zh: 那一瞬间，信玄突然感到愤懑无比。泰山崩于前而色不沮，黄河决于侧而神不惊。为了练就此种心态，信玄可谓费尽苦心，他认为自己确实达到了此等境界。

paragraphs.source_en: Even at Kawanakajima, when Kenshin charged into his headquarters, he had not leapt from his camp stool. Yet tonight, although he had foreseen that someone might shoot at him and had taken precautions, he had still been unable to suppress his alarm.

units.source_en: Even at Kawanakajima, when Kenshin charged into his headquarters, he had not leapt from his camp stool.
units.source_zh: 即使在川中岛时谦信杀进了本阵，他也没有从床几上跳起。

units.source_en: Yet tonight, although he had foreseen that someone might shoot at him and had taken precautions, he had still been unable to suppress his alarm.

units.source_zh: 但是今夜，尽管他已经预料到可能有人向他开枪，并为此作了准备，仍然不禁惊慌。

paragraphs.source_zh: 即使在川中岛时谦信杀进了本阵，他也没有从床几上跳起。但是今夜，尽管他已经预料到可能有人向他开枪，并为此作了准备，仍然不禁惊慌。

paragraphs.source_en: My discipline is still insufficient! After reproaching himself, Shingen was about to sit down again when his massive body began to sway. A fierce numbness shot from his right hip down to his foot. His knee buckled, and he fell headlong to the ground.

units.source_en: My discipline is still insufficient!
units.source_zh: 还是修炼得不够啊！

units.source_en: After reproaching himself, Shingen was about to sit down again when his massive body began to sway.
units.source_zh: 自责一番后，信玄正要坐回床几，巨大的身躯却摇摇晃晃起来。

units.source_en: A fierce numbness shot from his right hip down to his foot. His knee buckled, and he fell headlong to the ground.
units.source_zh: 一种强烈的麻木感从右腰直窜到脚，他膝盖一软，扑倒在地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 还是修炼得不够啊！自责一番后，信玄正要坐回床几，巨大的身躯却摇摇晃晃起来。一种强烈的麻木感从右腰直窜到脚，他膝盖一软，扑倒在地。

paragraphs.source_en: Shingen felt utterly humiliated. As he tried to push himself up with his right hand, he was suddenly horrified—his right hand had lost all sensation. An unnatural pain struck the back of his head, and the right side of his face pitched toward the earth.

units.source_en: Shingen felt utterly humiliated.
units.source_zh: 信玄顿觉狼狈不堪。

units.source_en: An unnatural pain struck the back of his head, and the right side of his face pitched toward the earth.
units.source_zh: 他感到后脑有种异样的疼痛感，右脸直向地面扑去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信玄顿觉狼狈不堪。他正要用右手支撑起身体时，突然大吃一惊——他的右手已经失去了知觉。他感到后脑有种异样的疼痛感，右脸直向地面扑去。

paragraphs.source_en: An attendant drew his sword and ran shouting toward Shingen.

units.source_en: “Our lord has been shot!”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公被火枪击中了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ugh!” At last Shingen vomited. What came out seemed partly food and partly clots of black blood, and he felt something sticky on his left cheek. Shingen had no choice but to admit that his old illness had returned.

units.source_en: “Ugh!”
At last Shingen vomited.
units.source_zh: 信玄终于吐了出来。

units.source_en: What came out seemed partly food and partly clots of black blood, and he felt something sticky on his left cheek.

units.source_en: Shingen had no choice but to admit that his old illness had returned.
units.source_zh: 信玄不得不承认，自己旧病复发了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哇！”信玄终于吐了出来。那东西好像是食物，又好像是黑色的血块，左脸上有种黏糊糊的感觉。信玄不得不承认，自己旧病复发了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not shout—” Shingen tried to roar the command, but the words would not come.

units.source_en: “Do not shout—” Shingen tried to roar the command, but the words would not come.

paragraphs.source_zh: “不要叫——”信玄想要怒喝，但仍然说不出来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not shout. Do not let the enemy discover us. All of you, be silent.” His feeble voice only made the personal guards rushing toward him more terrified and distraught.

paragraphs.source_en: On hearing the report, Ieyasu inwardly honored the sacrifice they had made, yet outwardly rebuked them: “What a useless lot!”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康听到报告，一面在内心赞叹他们付出了牺牲，一面却呵斥道：“真是一帮没用的家伙！”

paragraphs.source_en: The fall of Noda Castle would mark the day the great Takeda army launched its attack. Sakai Saemon-no-jō Tadatsugu had already been sent to Yoshida Castle, and Ishikawa Kazumasa to Nobuyasu at Okazaki Castle.

units.source_en: The fall of Noda Castle would mark the day the great Takeda army launched its attack.

paragraphs.source_zh: 野田城陷落之时，即武田大军发起攻击之日。酒井左卫门尉忠次已被派往吉田城，石川数正也被派往冈崎城信康处。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet even Ieyasu himself was powerless before Shingen’s vast army; Yoshida and Okazaki were no more than single-log bridges before a raging flood. Every sign suggested that the Oda reinforcements for which Ieyasu had waited so desperately would never come; nor was there any sign of troops from Uesugi Kenshin, his last thread of hope. But Ieyasu neither wavered nor panicked. He was gradually coming into his full maturity.

units.source_en: Yet even Ieyasu himself was powerless before Shingen’s vast army; Yoshida and Okazaki were no more than single-log bridges before a raging flood.

units.source_en: But Ieyasu neither wavered nor panicked. He was gradually coming into his full maturity.
units.source_zh: 但家康既不动摇，也不慌乱，他已经渐渐步入成熟。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但面对信玄大军，家康自己尚且无能为力，吉田和冈崎也不过相当于洪流面前的独木桥。种种迹象表明，令家康望穿秋水的织田援军已不可能到来；就是最后一线希望上杉谦信的援兵，也迟迟不见踪影。但家康既不动摇，也不慌乱，他已经渐渐步入成熟。

paragraphs.source_en: In his judgment, the man who would remain to hold Noda Castle afterward must be Yamagata Saburōbei Masakage. Masakage would surely keep Ieyasu’s main force firmly pinned there. The moment he saw any sign that Ieyasu meant to pursue Shingen, he would undoubtedly attack Hamamatsu Castle and thereby hold Ieyasu in check. How could the outnumbered Tokugawa army withstand an enemy assault from both front and rear? Should he establish a Pure Land in this mortal world, or choose the manner of a warrior’s death? These thoughts filled Ieyasu’s mind.

units.source_en: In his judgment, the man who would remain to hold Noda Castle afterward must be Yamagata Saburōbei Masakage.

units.source_en: How could the outnumbered Tokugawa army withstand an enemy assault from both front and rear?

units.source_en: Should he establish a Pure Land in this mortal world, or choose the manner of a warrior’s death?

units.source_en: These thoughts filled Ieyasu’s mind.
units.source_zh: 家康满脑子都在想这些。

paragraphs.source_zh: 照他的判断，此后留守野田城的应该是山县三郎兵卫昌景。那昌景定会在此牢牢盯住家康的主力。一旦看到家康有追击信玄的迹象，他无疑会袭击滨松城，以牵制家康。面对敌人的前后夹攻，势单力薄的德川军如何抵抗？是在人间建立净土世界，还是选择武士的死亡方式？家康满脑子都在想这些。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, Ieyasu had long ceased to be troubled by questions of life and death. The only thing left for him to consider was how he should die in fulfillment of his ambition. Beneath the silent moonlight, the shades of his dead retainers gathered around him, compelling him to think anew.

units.source_en: In truth, Ieyasu had long ceased to be troubled by questions of life and death. The only thing left for him to consider was how he should die in fulfillment of his ambition.
units.source_zh: 其实家康对于生死早已经没有了困惑，他现在唯一需要考虑的，是如何为实现志向而死。

units.source_en: Beneath the silent moonlight, the shades of his dead retainers gathered around him, compelling him to think anew.
units.source_zh: 寂静的月光下，那些死去家臣的幽灵包围住他，让他不得不重新思考。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实家康对于生死早已经没有了困惑，他现在唯一需要考虑的，是如何为实现志向而死。寂静的月光下，那些死去家臣的幽灵包围住他，让他不得不重新思考。
